name: Input Buffer
description: Configurable early-press and delayed-release input buffer (in physics ticks).

start-preset.name: Starting preset
start-preset.description: 0 Custom, 1 = 2/2, 2 = 4/4, 3 = 8/8, 4 = 16/8, 5 = Off. Press F6 in a level to cycle.

press-ticks.name: Press buffer (ticks)
press-ticks.description: Custom preset: while you hold the button in the air (cube/ball/robot/spider), the press is re-sent for this many ticks so a ring/pad reached slightly late still triggers. 0 = off.

wave-release-ticks.name: Wave release delay (ticks)
wave-release-ticks.description: Custom preset: delays releasing the button while in wave. Adds input lag, keep small. 0 = off.
